content: python-zstandard (PyPI: zstandard, 0.25.0, py>=3.9) is the richest zstd binding: streaming compress/decompress, precomputed dictionaries, zero-copy buffer protocol. LZ4 achieves 500+ MB/s/core compression, multi-GB/s decompression; zstd level 1 is in a similar range dropping into tens of MB/s only at high levels (19+). No Cortex-A72-specific benchmark found; x86 reference figures leave large headroom for this project's ~96 KB/s raw CAN data rate, so throughput is not the constraint -- ratio is, favoring zstd over LZ4 for the live radio link.
